entries.note: [match form: raw (identical in escaped form)] Minimal fix: deletes only the internal-ownership sentence (2 occurrences = tree + text of the /owner-approved/20260925 paragraph); the rest of the paragraph (HR/hiring access, six-month retention, optional unchecked 12-month consent, career@kairali.com, 30-day target, no newsletter) is all within the approved policy. ALTERNATIVE (coordinator's choice, equally authority-backed): replace the whole paragraph text with the verbatim approved notice: 'We use your application to assess your suitability and contact you about recruitment. Access is limited to authorized HR staff and people involved in hiring for the role. If your application is unsuccessful or withdrawn, we normally delete it within six months of closure, unless a documented retention obligation applies. With your separate permission, we may retain it for relevant future opportunities for up to 12 months. You can request access, correction or deletion at career@kairali.com. Successful applicants’ necessary records are retained under our employee-record policy.'. CONFLICT: tests/approved-content.smoke.mjs line 14 asserts /careers/ contains 'Sunaj' (and, for the alternative, 'unchecked by default'); the spec encodes the defect — do not edit the spec to pass; escalate per rule (g) before applying.
